# BYZ scope. No X1 event this month (the sync still runs): Constantinople is not ours, or the 1341 or 1352 civil war, or the turmoil of the vassal line (B2), is going on (design 3.3).
oe_itp_paused = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { owns = location:constantinople }
        has_variable = oe_cw_active
        has_variable = oe_cw2_active
        has_variable = oe_vas_turmoil
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The Galata chain (gen_s37_galata.py) has started and is not over: Genoa's tier is frozen and no Genoese X1 event fires (design 2.5.1). It starts on the first pulse of a 1337 game.
oe_itp_gal_running = {
    has_variable = oe_s37_gal_started
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_s37_gal_done }
}

oe_itp_gal_ven_busy = {

# BYZ scope. Venice's cap falls to 2: the author's reform 驱逐外夷 is done, or the venetian_quarter quarter that stood in Constantinople at the start is gone (vanilla flavor_byz.54 removes it too).
oe_itp_expelled_ven = {
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_ir_expel_done
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_itp_q_ven
            NOT = { location:constantinople = { has_building = building_type:venetian_quarter } }
        }
    }
}

}

# BYZ scope. Grain score -1: The chartered grain ships sail for us.
oe_itp_gr_convoy = {
    has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_convoy
}

# BYZ scope. Grain score -1: We hold a Black Sea grain port and either a navy of 6 or the mark of .8 b (oe_itp_own_grain).
oe_itp_gr_own = {
    oe_itp_grain_port = yes
    OR = { navy_size >= 6 has_variable = oe_itp_own_grain }
}

# BYZ scope. Grain score -1: Genoa holds a pledge and concession (tier 3) and is at peace with us.
oe_itp_gr_pledge = {
    country_exists = c:GEN
    var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 3
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:GEN }
}

# BYZ scope. Grain score -1: The empire's own grain posts on the Black Sea (the colonisation line, gen_colonization.py: BYZ variable oe_col_grain_posts, 2 or more).
oe_itp_gr_posts = {
    has_variable = oe_col_grain_posts
    var:oe_col_grain_posts >= 2
}

# BYZ scope. Interface (design 4.2): oe_itp_grain_ge = { n = 1 } - the grain score, as the last monthly sync stored it, is at least n (1 tight, 2 cut).
oe_itp_grain_ge = {
    has_variable = oe_itp_grain
    var:oe_itp_grain >= $n$
}

# BYZ scope. The City is short of grain (.7): the road is cut, and no such event in the last 60 months.
oe_itp_ok_7 = {
    has_variable = oe_itp_grain
    var:oe_itp_grain >= 2
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_cd7 }
}

# BYZ scope. Genoa can take a pledge for a grain treaty (.7 c): tier 2 with room above, no war with us, the Galata chain not running.
oe_itp_cand7_gen = {
    country_exists = c:GEN
    var:oe_itp_t_gen ?= 2
    oe_itp_room_gen = yes
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:GEN }
    oe_itp_gal_running = no
}

# BYZ scope. Venice can take a pledge for a grain treaty (.7 c): tier 2 with room above, no war with us, not frozen, the treaty not lapsed, the Galata chain not at its Venetian stages.
oe_itp_cand7_ven = {
    country_exists = c:VEN
    var:oe_itp_t_ven ?= 2
    oe_itp_room_ven = yes
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:VEN }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_frozen }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed }
    oe_itp_gal_ven_busy = no
}

# BYZ scope. The Genoese may offer a grain treaty (.8): the road has been tight (score 1) for 6 months, no chartered ships sail for us, Genoa holds tier 2 or more, is at peace with us and the Galata chain is not running; no such offer in the last 60 months.
oe_itp_ok_8 = {
    var:oe_itp_grain ?= 1
    has_variable = oe_itp_grain_m1
    var:oe_itp_grain_m1 >= 6
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_cd8 }
    NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_convoy }
    country_exists = c:GEN
    oe_itp_tier_ge_gen = { n = 2 }
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:GEN }
    oe_itp_gal_running = no
}

# Country scope (the republic picked in an action). Venice or Genoa at tier 2 or more (they carry the chartered grain).
oe_itp_tgt_big2 = {
    OR = {
        AND = { tag = VEN c:BYZ = { oe_itp_tier_ge_ven = { n = 2 } } }
        AND = { tag = GEN c:BYZ = { oe_itp_tier_ge_gen = { n = 2 } } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The Genoese will carry grain for us: Genoa exists, is at peace with us, and the Galata chain is not at its war stages.
oe_itp_gen_carries = {
    country_exists = c:GEN
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:GEN }
    oe_itp_gr_galata = no
}

# Country scope (the republic picked in an action). Genoa: the Galata chain is not at its war stages.
oe_itp_tgt_galpeace = {
    OR = {
        tag = VEN
        AND = { tag = GEN c:BYZ = { oe_itp_gr_galata = no } }
        OR = {
            AND = { tag = PIS c:BYZ = { NOT = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 } } }
            AND = { tag = FLO c:BYZ = { var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2 } }
        }
        tag = RAG
    }
}

# Country scope. oe_itp_grain_ships may pick this republic.
oe_itp_gs_ok = {
    oe_itp_slot_country = yes
    oe_itp_tgt_big2 = yes
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
    oe_itp_tgt_pact = yes
    oe_itp_tgt_galpeace = yes
}

# BYZ scope. oe_itp_grain_ships is open to us: the road is tight or cut, no chartered ships sail for us yet, we have 2 months of income in gold and a republic can carry the grain (readout).
oe_itp_gs_open = {
    oe_itp_grain_ge = { n = 1 }
    NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_itp_grain_convoy }
    gold >= oe_itp_m2
    owns = location:constantinople
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { oe_itp_gs_ok = yes } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { oe_itp_gs_ok = yes } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Ragusa may ask for a chrysobull (.10): it exists, is no Venetian subject, holds a trade treaty, thinks well of us (opinion >= 0), is at peace with us, has not asked in the last 120 months; and Venice is gone, holds a trade treaty or less, has let its treaty lapse, or thinks ill of us (design 3.5: the chrysobull of 1451 was meant partly to vex Venice).
oe_itp_ok_10 = {
    country_exists = c:RAG
    oe_itp_rag_bound = no
    var:oe_itp_t_rag ?= 1
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:RAG }
    c:RAG = { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 0 } }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_itp_cd10 }
    OR = {
        NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN }
        NOT = { oe_itp_tier_ge_ven = { n = 2 } }
        has_variable = oe_itp_ven_lapsed
        AND = { country_exists = c:VEN c:VEN = { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < 0 } } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The Florentines ask for the Pisans' old house (.11): queued when the fourth slot passed to Florence, Florence still holds it and is at peace with us.
oe_itp_ok_11 = {
    has_variable = oe_itp_q11
    var:oe_itp_slot4 ?= 2
    country_exists = c:FLO
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:FLO }
}
